Maya (Finance): FYI Novus Labs submitted invoice INV-2026-0892 today for $12,450 referencing PO-2018-009 which was closed years ago. No approver on file (Riley departed 2025). Attachment uploaded.

invoicobot: PDF uploaded: https://files.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-0892.pdf :page_facing_up:

Lina (AP): Putting this on hold in AP queue — OCR shows PO string as "0-000" which doesn't match our PO registry. Need procurement to confirm.

Arjun (Procure): That PO looks like legacy SOW work. @Jared can you check with the vendor whether this ties to SOW 2018-12 or a renewal? If tied to SOW, procurement can generate a retro PO.

Jared (Vendor Ops): Reached out to Novus rep. They say invoice is for a hardware replacement under SOW 2018-12. Asked them to send the SOW scan and internal ticket. Uploading when received.

Maya (Finance): Recording invoice metadata for audit:
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0892
Vendor: Novus Labs (NL-482)
Amount: 12,450.00
Invoice date: 2026-03-15
PO referenced: PO-2018-009 (closed)
```

Arjun (Procure): If Novus provides the SOW, procurement will create a one-time retro PO and route approvals to legacy-approvers@redwood.com. Maya, please confirm cost center and GL.

Maya (Finance): Cost center ENG-PLAT; expense label "legacy-hardware". GL code 5801 will work.

Lina (AP): /hold-invoice INV-2026-0892 — invoice status ON_HOLD until match.

invoicobot: Invoice INV-2026-0892 status changed to ON_HOLD by Lina (AP) at 2026-03-18T14:27:00Z

Jared (Vendor Ops): Uploaded SOW: https://files.redwood.com/vendor_docs/novus_sow_2018-12.pdf and vendor ticket NOVUS-TKT-9921. Vendor confirmed bank details unchanged.

Arjun (Procure): Opened procurement ticket INF-3421 for retro PO creation: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/INF-3421. Assigned to procurement-legacy. ETA 2 business days.

Maya (Finance): Good. If procurement can't approve by EOD Friday, AP will request a vendor-issued credit to avoid aging.

Lina (AP): Agreed. I'll block payment until we have a PO or vendor credit.

Jared (Vendor Ops): Novus is okay waiting 48 hours for the retro PO. They'll accept either the PO or a credit note.

Maya (Finance): I'll monitor INF-3421 and update payment queue. Keeping this thread as the single source of truth. :thumbsup:

Arjun (Procure): I'll follow up with legacy-approvers and ping procurement-legacy channel.

Lina (AP): Thanks team, closing loop here once matched.
